study type: Bioinformatics and experimental molecular study (retrospective data analysis with in vitro validation)
cohort: The study utilized RNA sequencing data from the GSE14821 dataset and validated findings using clinical placenta samples from patients with early-onset preeclampsia and control placenta samples.
finding: The study identified 4436 differentially expressed lncRNAs and established a regulatory lncRNA-mRNA network in early-onset preeclampsia placentas, closely related to the cytokine-cytokine receptor and HIF-1 pathways, with specific lncRNAs promoting trophoblast cell proliferation.
cross-section timing: Placenta samples were collected at the time of delivery/termination of pregnancy.
gest_age: The study focused on 'early-onset preeclampsia', but specific gestational ages for the cohort were not mentioned.
